s.n: Little Red's basket cheese and herb buns
s.note: Soft pull-apart bread buns with cheddar, chives and thyme, baked golden with a melted cheese top
s.how: Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp caster sugar, 1 tsp salt, 300ml warm milk and 40g soft butter and knead for 10 minutes. Knead in 100g grated cheddar, 2 tbsp chopped chives and 1 tsp thyme leaves. Cover and prove for 1 hour until doubled. Divide into 12 balls and set close together in a lined 23cm square tin, then prove for 30 minutes. Brush with beaten egg, scatter with another 50g cheddar and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden. Cool for 10 minutes and pull apart into a basket.

s.note: Toasted baguette with ricotta and bright crushed broad beans, mint, garlic and lemon
s.how: Cook 500g frozen broad beans in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain and cool, then pop the beans out of their skins. Crush roughly with 1 crushed garlic clove, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp chopped mint and 40ml olive oil, and season. Brush 1cm slices of baguette with the rest of 80ml oil and toast until golden. Spread with 150g ricotta and pile on the beans.

m.n: Granny's cottage chicken and mushroom pot pie
m.note: Chicken thigh, leek, mushrooms and thyme in a creamy mustard sauce under a deep golden puff pastry lid
m.how: Season 800g diced boneless chicken thighs and brown in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan, then lift out. Soften 1 sliced leek, 250g halved button mushrooms, 2 crushed garlic cloves and the leaves from 3 thyme sprigs in the pan. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock, 150ml thickened cream and 1 tsp Dijon mustard. Return the chicken and simmer for 15 minutes until thick. Stir in 2 tbsp chopped parsley, season and spoon into a 2 litre pie dish, then cool for 10 minutes. Cover with 2 sheets of puff pastry, press the edges, brush with beaten egg, cut a steam hole and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

w.note: Soft buttery sweet bread twisted into a long plait around cinnamon apple, glazed with honey, with whipped cream
w.how: Mix 400g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g caster sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 150ml warm milk and 2 eggs, then knead in 80g soft butter bit by bit until glossy. Prove for 1 1/2 hours until doubled. Roll out to 40cm by 30cm, spread with 30g soft butter and scatter with 60g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 grated, squeezed green apples. Roll up from a long side, cut in half lengthways and twist the two strands together, cut sides up, into a long plait. Prove on a lined tray for 30 minutes, then bake at 180C for 30 minutes until deep golden. Brush with 2 tbsp warm honey and serve in slices with 200ml lightly whipped cream.

d.note: Thick, frothy cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream, vanilla and a little honey, dusted with nutmeg
d.how: Blend 800ml cold milk, 6 scoops of vanilla ice cream, 1 tsp vanilla extract and 1 tbsp honey until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses and dust each with a pinch of ground nutmeg.
